# betterado_repository_policy_file_path_pattern (Resource)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "betterado_project" "example" {
  name = "ExampleProject"
}

data "betterado_git_repository" "example" {
  name       = "ExampleRepo"
  project_id = data.betterado_project.example.id
}

resource "betterado_repository_policy_file_path_pattern" "example" {
  project_id  = data.betterado_project.example.id
  enabled     = true
  blocking    = true

  repository_ids    = [data.betterado_git_repository.example.id]
  filepath_patterns = ["*.exe", "*.dll", "/secrets/*"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filepath_patterns` (List of String)
- `project_id` (String)

### Optional

- `blocking` (Boolean)
- `enabled` (Boolean)
- `repository_ids` (List of String)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
